hooks.description: A6 — append one line per tool call to the session trace. Consumed by the validator (cascade banned-pattern + already_read_files audit) and the Stop-hook allowlist suggester. Truncated each session by the reaper; never rotated. Anchored + non-blocking.

W3 cascade cap (PostToolUse): classifies just-completed Bash command, increments cascade depth on validation FAIL, sets sticky banned-flag on package-install / symlink / full-monorepo-test / prettier-recheck. State: .claude/state/cascade-depth.json. Advisory only — the PreToolUse companion does the hard block.
Kill orphan browser/MCP processes at session end (anthropics/claude-code#15861). Stdout redirected to log file.
W2 — Reset per-turn Engram budget counter at session/turn end. Anchored + non-blocking.
W3 — Reset cascade-depth state at session/turn end. Anchored + non-blocking.
Read-only enforcement for the validator subagent (reads agent_type from stdin payload). Path anchored to $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR so the hook survives non-root CWDs.
B1 — branch gate: refuse impl writes outside feat/<change> or feat/<bundle>. Anchored.
B3 — lint scope guard: block repo-wide lint/format that exceeds task scope. Anchored.

W3 cascade cap (PreToolUse): hard-blocks the next Bash call when cascade depth > 1 OR a banned mid-wave pattern (pnpm install / symlink debug / full-monorepo test / repeat prettier --check) was triggered earlier in this wave. State: .claude/state/cascade-depth.json. See agent_docs/cascade-policy.md.
W2 — Per-turn Engram budget enforcement. Blocks 3rd mem_search / 2nd mem_get_observation / 2nd mem_context. Warns on 3rd mem_save. See agent_docs/memory-budget.md.
rtk — advisory hint to prefix Bash commands with rtk for token compression (no-op when rtk binary missing). Run `rtk init -g` for protocol-correct automatic rewriting.
Prune stale .claude/state clutter (legacy *.bak, retired perf logs) and truncate the session trace at session start. Anchored + non-blocking.
